criteria.final_justification: Search parameters (destination, dates, 2 adults, 1 room) are explicitly supported by the results-page URL parameters in the latest states. No adjustment needed.

criteria.criterion: Apply required visible filters (rating and budget) where available
criteria.final_justification: Rating 8+ filter is supported as applied (review_score=80 and “Very Good: 8+” visible). Budget-below-€750 is not supported as applied; only a per-night budget widget is shown and there’s no confirmation of adjustment or manual enforcement. The agent’s claimed overlay/blocker is not sufficiently confirmed as an uncontrollable blocker preventing all budget handling (later states show results with totals and do not clearly confirm a non-dismissible overlay as the cause). Keep partial credit.

criteria.criterion: Open and review Hotel 1 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
criteria.final_justification: Criterion requires opening a property and capturing cancellation terms along with other fields. Evidence shows the agent stayed on the results list and did not open a hotel detail page; cancellation terms for the hotel are not evidenced. Some fields (price/rating/area/distance) are visible on the card, so minimal partial credit is warranted, but not full.

criteria.criterion: Open and review Hotel 2 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of opening/reviewing a second hotel page. Some required fields can be gleaned from list cards, and one listing shows cancellation snippets, but the criterion is about a reviewed/opened second property with all fields captured. Award minimal partial credit for the partial on-card data availability only.

criteria.criterion: Open and review Hotel 3 that qualifies (or best available if none qualify)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not open/review a third hotel page. As with prior criteria, only partial list-card info exists and cancellation terms are not captured for a distinct third opened property. Minimal partial credit only.

criteria.criterion: Compare the three hotels on required dimensions
criteria.final_justification: Required comparison across three hotels on all five dimensions is not delivered in the agent output and is not supported by evidence. While the results list contains enough data to attempt a partial comparison, the agent did not provide it. Score should be near zero.
No recommendation was made, so the criterion is not satisfied. (Not booking is satisfied implicitly, but the criterion requires a recommendation with rationale.)
